content: Google Cloud Online Boutique (microservices-demo): 11 polyglot microservices over gRPC — frontend (Go, session IDs, NO signup/login), cartservice (C#+Redis), productcatalogservice (Go, serves products from a JSON FILE, search+get-by-id), currencyservice, paymentservice (mock charge returns txn ID), shippingservice (mock quote+ship), emailservice (Python mock), checkoutservice (SYNCHRONOUS gRPC orchestration, no broker), recommendationservice, adservice, loadgenerator. Shows the other canonical demo skips identity entirely and uses sync orchestration — this project's JWT auth + Kafka async spine is a deliberate point of difference.
